```plato

    // The leftmost of the pool points in [start, end). Precondition: non-empty.
    LeftmostOfRange(points: Array<Point2D>, start: Integer, end: Integer): Point2D
        => points.Slice(start, end)
            .Reduce(points[start], (best, p) => p.IsFurtherLeft(best) ? p : best);
```
